mitre.technique_name: Use Alternate Authentication Material: Pass the Ticket

description: Adversaries may Pass the Ticket (PtT) using stolen Kerberos tickets to move laterally within an environment, bypassing normal system access controls. Pass the Ticket is a method of authenticating to a system using Kerberos tickets without having access to an account's password.
artifacts: Kerberos AP-REQ messages (TCP/88, UDP/88) presenting a previously obtained service ticket
Absence of preceding AS-REQ/TGS-REQ exchanges for the authenticating principal on the host
RPC endpoint mapper connections (TCP/135) followed by DCERPC bind using SPNEGO/Kerberos (not NTLMSSP)
SMB session setup (TCP/445) authenticating via Kerberos rather than NTLM
DCOM activation traffic (TCP/135 + dynamic high ports) with Kerberos authentication consistent with WMI-based execution
DRSUAPI replication calls (DCSync) over DCERPC when a ticket with sufficient privileges is used
Remote service creation (SVCCTL), WMI Win32_Process::Create, or writes to ADMIN$/C$ following Kerberos authentication
Service ticket presented for service hosts (cifs/, host/, HTTP/) on target systems from unexpected source hosts

pcaps.name: Internal Pass-the-Ticket execution (impacket wmiexec)
pcaps.description: Internal authenticated Pass-the-Ticket lateral movement using impacket wmiexec.py with a cached Kerberos ticket, showing Kerberos AP-REQ authentication and DCOM/WMI Win32_Process::Create invocation for remote command execution.

pcaps.name: Internal Pass-the-Ticket execution (impacket smbexec)
pcaps.description: Internal authenticated Pass-the-Ticket lateral movement using impacket smbexec.py with a cached Kerberos ticket, showing Kerberos AP-REQ authentication over SMB and RPC-based service creation for remote command execution.

pcaps.name: Internal Pass-the-Ticket execution (impacket psexec)
pcaps.description: Internal authenticated Pass-the-Ticket lateral movement using impacket psexec.py with a cached Kerberos ticket, showing Kerberos AP-REQ authentication over SMB, ADMIN$ share access, and RPC-based service creation for remote command execution.

pcaps.name: Internal Pass-the-Ticket credential dump (impacket secretsdump)
pcaps.description: Internal authenticated Pass-the-Ticket credential dump using impacket secretsdump.py with a cached Kerberos ticket, showing Kerberos AP-REQ authentication and DRSUAPI replication (DCSync) calls to extract credential material for a target user.
